query:
UPDATE git_sync_synced_head SET tests_dispatched_at = now()
           WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND repo_resource_path = $2 AND branch = $3 AND sha = $4
             AND (tests_dispatched_at IS NULL
                  OR (ci_test_job_ids IS NULL
                      AND tests_dispatched_at < now() - make_interval(secs => $5)))
           RETURNING true as "claimed!"
